checks.summary: A font the document uses is unavailable or substituted, so the rendering may differ from the author's.
The product engine exposes no font diagnostics, so the fonts the document uses were not checked.
The document contains comments, which a delivered document usually should not keep.
The document has no readable text, tables or images.

The document holds the banner or footer text that a save without a license wrote into the file, such as 'Created with an evaluation copy of Aspose.Words'; a license does not remove it. Checked only with a license.
A heading ends a page after prior content while its body starts on the next page.
A drawing object extends beyond the physical page boundary.
A laid-out page has no visible body text, table rows or drawing objects.
A page contains more than one explicit page-break control.
A page after the first holds only a sliver of visible content, such as a stranded line.
The document contains tracked revisions, which a visual-only repair must not accept.
Visible body text on a page is larger than 72 pt.
Visible body text on a page is smaller than 7 pt.

v2/words/compare-result.description: Result of words compare: the revisions a semantic comparison of two documents found, and the redline document when one is written.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

identical.description: Whether the comparison found no revisions.

revisions.description: The revisions the comparison found, counted by type.

samples.description: The first revisions the comparison found.

output.description: The redline document that tracks every revision; absent when none is written.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

text.description: The text of the revision's run, cut to 300 characters and an ellipsis; absent for a paragraph mark.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

pages.description: The 1-based pages the output holds, as --pages selected them; absent for every page.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

v2/words/create-result.description: Result of words create: the document written.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

v2/words/document-info.description: Structural information returned by words inspect.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

kind.description: The kind of file inspected: always document.

document.description: The summary every inspect returns, whatever details it asks for.

sections.description: Each section's page setup and headers and footers; returned with --detail sections.

outline.description: The headings in document order; returned with --detail outline.

styles.description: The names of the styles the document defines, in ordinal order; returned with --detail styles.

fields.description: The fields in every story; returned with --detail fields.

bookmarks.description: The bookmark names, in ordinal order; returned with --detail bookmarks.

comments.description: The comments, replies included; returned with --detail comments.

revisions.description: The tracked changes in document order, one entry per change; returned with --detail revisions. A replacement is a deletion followed by an insertion. document.revisionCount counts the revisions the document stores, one per run, paragraph mark or other changed node, so it can exceed the entries here.

images.description: The embedded images in every story; returned with --detail images.

properties.description: The title, author, subject and keywords document properties by name, null for one the document does not set; returned with --detail properties.

fonts.description: The fonts the document's text is drawn with, per character script; not the font table. Returned with --detail fonts.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

block.description: The 1-based body block the comment is anchored in.

documentSummary.description: The summary of a document that every inspect returns.

blockCount.description: The number of blocks: the paragraphs and tables directly in section bodies.

pageCount.description: The number of pages in the document's layout.

wordCount.description: The word count the document's built-in properties record.

revisionsPresent.description: Whether the document holds tracked changes.

revisionCount.description: The revisions the document stores, one per run, paragraph mark or other changed node; list the changes with --detail revisions.

revisionAuthors.description: The distinct authors of the tracked changes, in ordinal order.

commentCount.description: The comments in the document, replies included; list them with --detail comments.

protection.description: The editing restriction: none, or the protect operation mode that sets it; every SDK protection type maps to one of these.

signed.description: Whether the document carries a digital signature.

hasMacros.description: Whether the document holds macros (a VBA project); an output other than docm, dotm, doc, dot or wordml drops them and reports MACROS_DROPPED.

type.description: The SDK's name of the field type, such as FieldDate.

scope.description: The story that holds the field, named as query search names its scopes.

block.description: The body block that holds the field, or that anchors the comment or note holding it; absent in headers and footers.

code.description: The field code, such as DATE with its switches.

result.description: The result a reader sees, with the results of nested fields in place of their codes.

headerFooterData.description: One header or footer of a section, named as set_header, set_footer and set_page_numbers name it: its location and kind, and its visible text as paragraphs.

location.description: Whether it is a header or a footer, as set_page_numbers names it.

kind.description: Which pages it shows on, as set_header and set_footer name it.

paragraphs.description: The visible text of each paragraph, as set_header and set_footer take it.

imageData.description: One embedded image in any story; its size is in points.

scope.description: The story that holds the image, named as query search names its scopes.

block.description: The body block that holds the image, or that anchors the comment or note holding it; absent in headers and footers.

name.description: The name of the shape that holds the image.

block.description: The 1-based block of the heading paragraph.

revisionData.description: One tracked change in document order: its 1-based number, which accept_revisions and reject_revisions accept, its type, author, the date the document records and the text it inserts, deletes or moves.

revision.description: The 1-based number of the change in this list, which the revisions of accept_revisions and reject_revisions accept.

date.description: The date and time the document records, as ISO 8601 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss without a time zone; absent when none is recorded.

scope.description: The story that holds the change, named as query search names its scopes; absent for style definition changes.

block.description: The body block that holds the change, or that anchors the comment or note holding it; absent in headers and footers and for style definition changes.

text.description: The text an insertion adds, a deletion removes or a move relocates; a longer text is cut to 300 characters and an ellipsis; absent for format and style definition changes.

section.description: The 1-based section number that section operations accept.

orientation.description: The orientation of the section's pages.

headersFooters.description: The headers and footers the section defines itself; a kind it does not define continues from the previous section.

columnCount.description: The number of cells in the widest row.

style.description: The table style the table uses, accepted by insert_table's style; omitted for the default Table Normal style.

v2/words/document-read.description: Windowed block projection returned by words query blocks. Its window counts blocks: the total is the blocks the range, section and scope select. window.next starts again at a block whose content was truncated and doubles --max-chars when that block alone exceeded the budget.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

kind.description: The kind of file read: always document.

blockCount.description: The document's block count, whatever the range, section and scope select.

blocks.description: The blocks of this window, in document order.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and how to continue.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

blockData.description: A paragraph or table directly owned by a section body.

block.description: The 1-based block number that operation block addresses accept.

type.description: Whether the block is a paragraph or a table.

section.description: The 1-based section that holds the block.

listLabel.description: The number Word draws before a numbered list paragraph, such as 6.2; bullets are not reported. The paragraph's text leaves it out; search snippets, find and heading addresses, extracted text and table cells read it before the text, followed by a space.

style.description: The name of a paragraph's style.

headingLevel.description: A heading paragraph's level, 1 for Heading 1.

runs.description: The runs of the visible text, in order: their text joins to the paragraph's text, without field codes, deleted text or anchored comments and footnotes. Returned in full scope.

paragraphFormat.description: The paragraph's indents, spacing and alignment, returned in full scope.

breakAfter.description: The break that follows this block: a page break, including one that starts the next paragraph, or a section break after the last block of a section.

columnCount.description: The number of cells in a table's widest row.

cells.description: The text of each cell by row; a numbered list paragraph in a cell starts with its number and a space.

contentTruncated.description: Returned document text shares the max-chars budget, including repeated projections. Re-read this item with a larger budget for omitted content.

blockImageData.description: One image in a paragraph block; its size is in points.

block.description: The 1-based block that holds the image.

name.description: The name of the shape that holds the image.

paragraphFormatData.description: The format a paragraph has, from its own settings and its style, in points; returned in full scope.

alignment.description: Such as left, center, right, justify or distributed.

firstLineIndent.description: The first line's indent; negative for a hanging indent.

lineSpacing.description: Lines for the multiple rule, where 1 is single spacing; points otherwise.

runData.description: One run of a paragraph's visible text and its formatting, returned in full scope.

font.description: The East Asian font when the run starts with a Chinese, Japanese or Korean character, otherwise the Latin font.

latinFont.description: The font of the run's Latin text.

eastAsianFont.description: The font of the run's Chinese, Japanese and Korean text.

v2/words/edit-result.description: Result of words edit: one operation batch, applied or checked, and the checks run on the written document.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

output.description: The written document; absent for a dry run.

dryRun.description: Whether the batch was only checked, writing nothing.

applied.description: The outcome of each operation, in batch order.

backup.description: The backup of the replaced file, when the edit wrote over an existing file.

pagesTouched.description: The output pages the batch changed: those of the blocks and sections the operations addressed or inserted, of replaced text, and of the content that took the place of removed blocks. An operation whose only target is document can change any page.

verification.description: The checks run on the written document after reopening it.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

ok.description: Whether the written document passed every check.

semanticChangesDetected.description: Whether the written document's content differs from the input's once both accept every tracked change.

fieldCount.description: The number of fields in the written document.

revisionCount.description: The number of revisions the written document stores.

protection.description: The editing restriction: none, or the protect operation mode that sets it; every SDK protection type maps to one of these.

v2/words/extract-result.description: Result of words extract: the files written for the images, comments, text or tables extracted.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

what.description: What was extracted, as --what named it.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

block.description: The 1-based block the image or table comes from.

v2/words/ops.description: The operation document of words edit --ops. Every block address resolves against the document as it was before the first operation, so an insertion does not shift a later operation's anchor. Operations apply in order. Without --best-effort the batch is atomic: if any operation fails, no file is written. With --best-effort the operations that succeed are kept and saved, each one that fails is reported, and the command exits 8 when any failed; an invalid document or a failure inside the document engine still writes nothing.

ifMatch.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint the input must still have; the edit fails when it changed.

id.description: A correlation id echoed in the result; op-0001 style ids are assigned when omitted.

accept_revisions.description: Accepts tracked revisions: all, one author's, or the listed changes; author and revisions cannot be combined.

author.description: The author whose revisions are decided; a name no revision has changes nothing and reports AUTHOR_NO_MATCH.

revisions.description: The 1-based revision numbers of the changes words inspect --detail revisions lists, numbered as the document was before the batch. Such a decision comes before every operation other than a revision decision, and lists together the changes that share a node and type, as its error names them.

add_comment.description: Adds a comment on a paragraph block.

add_section.description: Adds an empty section at the start, the end or after a section.

after.description: The 1-based section the new section follows; set exactly when position is after.

pageSetup.description: Page setup applied over the neighbouring section's.

add_watermark.description: Adds a text or image watermark; color and font apply to a text watermark only.

text.description: The watermark text; Word holds at most 200 characters.

imagePath.description: The watermark image, relative to the working directory.

faded.description: Semi-transparent text or a washed-out image.

font.description: The text font; when omitted, East Asian text takes the default East Asian font of a Chinese, Japanese or Korean document, or else Microsoft YaHei.

append_document.description: Appends the sections of a local document, each with the headers and footers it defines; a kind it does not define continues from the section before it.

path.description: The document, relative to the working directory.

importFormatMode.description: Which definition a style both documents name takes: the appended document's (keepSource) or this document's (useDestination). Headers and footers are not styles and come with their sections either way.

apply_list.description: Makes the paragraphs of target blocks one new bullet or numbered list.

define_style.description: Creates or updates a named paragraph style; omitted settings keep their values.

font.description: The font of Latin and East Asian text.

latinFont.description: The font of Latin text, in place of font's.

eastAsianFont.description: The font of Chinese, Japanese and Korean text, in place of font's.

spaceBefore.description: Space before the paragraph, in points.

spaceAfter.description: Space after the paragraph, in points.

delete_blocks.description: Deletes one or more canonical blocks.

delete_section.description: Deletes one section; a document keeps at least one.

format_table.description: Sets how one table block breaks across pages; omitted settings keep their values. keepTogether true also stops rows breaking, so it cannot be combined with allowRowBreakAcrossPages true.

keepTogether.description: true keeps the whole table on one page when it fits: no row breaks across pages, and every paragraph keeps with the next except the last paragraph of each last-row cell. false clears keep-with-next on those same paragraphs and leaves the row setting.

allowRowBreakAcrossPages.description: Whether the text of each row may split across a page break.

headerRowCount.description: The first rows repeated as a heading on every page the table spans; 0 clears it. At most the table's row count.

keepWithNext.description: Whether the last paragraph of each last-row cell keeps with the paragraph after the table, keeping the table with it.

format_text.description: Applies character formatting to the runs of target blocks; omitted settings keep their values.

font.description: The font of Latin and East Asian text.

latinFont.description: The font of Latin text, in place of font's.

eastAsianFont.description: The font of Chinese, Japanese and Korean text, in place of font's.

insert_break.description: Inserts a page break, or splits the section at a block boundary.

insert_field.description: Inserts a Word field in a new paragraph.

code.description: The field code, such as DATE.

insert_hyperlink.description: Inserts a hyperlink in a new paragraph.

insert_image.description: Inserts a local image in a new paragraph.

path.description: The image, relative to the working directory.

width.description: The width in points; the image's own when omitted.

height.description: The height in points; the image's own when omitted.

inline.description: Whether the image sits in the text line rather than floating with square wrapping.

insert_markdown.description: Imports Markdown at a block boundary.

insert_paragraphs.description: Inserts structured paragraphs at a block boundary.

insert_table.description: Inserts a table at a block boundary; cells must fit the table's rows and columns.

columnCount.description: The column count; Word allows at most 63.

cells.description: Cell text by row, then column; cells beyond it stay empty.

insert_toc.description: Inserts and updates a table of contents.

mail_merge.description: Runs a mail merge from a data file or inline rows: one copy of the document per row, or one region repeated per row.

path.description: A JSON array of flat objects, or a CSV file with a header row, relative to the working directory; it must hold at least one row.

inline.description: Merge rows of field values by field name, read as a data file's are: a number or Boolean merges as its JSON text.

regions.description: Whether the rows repeat the template's one TableStart/TableEnd region.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the protection password; no password when omitted.

reject_revisions.description: Rejects tracked revisions: all, one author's, or the listed changes; author and revisions cannot be combined.

author.description: The author whose revisions are decided; a name no revision has changes nothing and reports AUTHOR_NO_MATCH.

revisions.description: The 1-based revision numbers of the changes words inspect --detail revisions lists, numbered as the document was before the batch. Such a decision comes before every operation other than a revision decision, and lists together the changes that share a node and type, as its error names them.

remove_comments.description: Removes comments: all, or one author's.

author.description: The author whose comments are removed; a name no comment has changes nothing and reports AUTHOR_NO_MATCH.

repeat_table_row.description: Repeats one template row of a table block once per item, in order, and removes the template row. Each copy keeps the row's formatting and replaces every {{key}} placeholder with the item's value as literal text in the placeholder's formatting; an item without a key for one of the row's placeholders fails the operation.

row.description: The 1-based template row; when omitted, the table's one row that contains a {{key}} placeholder.

items.description: Placeholder values by key, one object per row copy, read as a data file's are: a number or Boolean as its JSON text and null as empty text. An empty list removes the template row.

path.description: A JSON array of flat objects, or a CSV file with a header row, relative to the working directory.

replace_text.description: Replaces literal or regular-expression text within a document scope.

replace.description: With regex, .NET substitutions such as $1 and ${name} apply; write $$ for a literal $.

regex.description: Whether find is a .NET regular expression rather than literal text.

scope.description: body is the main text without the comments and footnotes it anchors; footnotes include endnotes. Field codes and text a tracked change deletes are never replaced.

maxReplacementCount.description: The most matches replaced; every match when omitted.

set_default_font.description: Sets the font of every paragraph and character style.

font.description: The font of Latin and East Asian text.

latinFont.description: The font of Latin text, in place of font's.

eastAsianFont.description: The font of Chinese, Japanese and Korean text, in place of font's.

size.description: The font size in points; sizes are kept when omitted.

set_footer.description: Replaces one kind of section footer with paragraphs or with Markdown.

section.description: The 1-based section; every section when omitted.

kind.description: Which pages it shows on; first and even also turn on the section setting that shows it.

paragraphs.description: Plain paragraphs, one per item, in the paragraph and character format of the first paragraph they replace, such as its alignment, or in Word's Header or Footer style when there is none.

set_header.description: Replaces one kind of section header with paragraphs or with Markdown.

section.description: The 1-based section; every section when omitted.

kind.description: Which pages it shows on; first and even also turn on the section setting that shows it.

paragraphs.description: Plain paragraphs, one per item, in the paragraph and character format of the first paragraph they replace, such as its alignment, or in Word's Header or Footer style when there is none.

set_page_numbers.description: Adds or aligns a PAGE field in the primary header or footer and sets page numbering.

section.description: The 1-based section; every section when omitted.

start.description: The number of the section's first page; numbering continues when omitted.

set_page_setup.description: Applies page setup to one section, or to every section.

section.description: The 1-based section; every section when omitted.

set_properties.description: Sets built-in and custom document properties; omitted properties keep their values.

custom.description: Custom properties by name; a null value removes the property.

set_style.description: Applies an existing paragraph style to target blocks.

set_table_cell.description: Replaces the text of one cell of a table block.

set_text.description: Replaces the inline content of paragraph blocks, or the text a bookmark encloses.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the protection password.

update_fields.description: Updates the tables of contents, or every field and the page layout.

marginInput.description: Page margins in points; omitted margins keep their values.

pageSetupInput.description: Page size, orientation, margins and column settings; omitted settings keep their values.

pages.description: 1-based pages and ranges separated by commas, such as 1-3,7,9-; a range with no end runs to the last page, and a range must not end before it starts.

paragraphInput.description: One paragraph supplied to an insertion operation.

style.description: An existing paragraph style. Without it, the paragraph continues the paragraph before the insertion point, or with listLevel the existing item at that level it joins, as Word's Enter does: its indents, spacing, alignment and the run format of its last text, or after a heading the heading style's next style.

listLevel.description: Makes the paragraph a list item at this level. When the anchor is a list item, it joins the anchor's list if that list defines the level, else the list of the nearest item at this level under the same parent, and without style continues that list's nearest existing item at this level, if any, with the indents it sets on itself. When the anchor is no list item, or no such list exists, it joins one new bullet list.

webLink.description: An absolute http://, https:// or mailto: URL.

wordsTarget.description: A block address: exactly one of block, blocks, bookmark, heading or find.

find.description: Visible text that locates a block, matched case-insensitively.

nth.description: The 1-based match of a heading or find address; the first when omitted.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: One written image per rendered page, in page order.

dpi.description: The raster resolution of png and jpeg output; absent for svg.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

v2/words/search-result.description: Result of words query search: one window of search hits; its window counts hits and continues with --skip.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

pattern.description: The text or regular expression searched for.

hits.description: The hits of this window, in document order.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and how to continue.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

block.description: The body block that holds the hit; absent in headers and footers.

section.description: The section whose body, header or footer holds the hit.

scope.description: The story that holds the hit.

location.description: In a header or footer, which one holds the hit; absent elsewhere.

kind.description: In a header or footer, its kind as set_header and set_footer name it; absent elsewhere.

snippet.description: The text of the paragraph, comment or note that holds the hit, cut to 300 characters and an ellipsis.

v2/words/split-result.description: Result of words split: the parts the document was split into, in document order.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: The written parts, in document order.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

source.description: What of the document the part holds: section-N, page-N or blocks-S-E.
